in_arabic.name: Kahlaa
in_arabic.long_meaning: Kahlaa هو اسم عربي إسلامي يحمل معنى عميقاً في الثقافة الإسلامية. Derived from the Arabic root 'kahl', meaning 'to be pure, clean, or free from impurities'. In Islamic tradition, Kahlaa represents the spiritual purification of the soul, achieved through acts of obedience to Allah.
